summary: Re-test verification after CheckoutPage navigation race fix and product migration backfill. ALL critical flows now pass. (1) Guest checkout: add to cart → /checkout → fill form → Place Order → user lands on /order-success with order number CB-20260516-F7BBF100 displayed and 'Track This Order' button visible. (2) Track This Order button → /track → entering order number renders full order details correctly. (3) Authenticated checkout (session_token cookie set): order CB-20260516-0B23FC79 placed and appears in /my-orders list (4 orders total for test user). (4) Backend migration: GET /api/products now returns color_variants (list), total_sold (int), video_url fields on all 10 products. (5) Login-gated review submission still works: rating + comment posted, 'Review submitted!' toast shown, review appears in product reviews list. No regressions observed.
critical_code_review_comments: CheckoutPage.jsx fix is correct — `submitted` flag guards the empty-cart fallback useEffect, and navigate is called before clear(). Order state is preserved on /order-success via router state.
OrderSuccessPage.jsx navigate('/') now correctly wrapped in useEffect — no more render-time navigation antipattern.
server.py startup migration backfills color_variants/video_url/total_sold defaults idempotently — verified all 10 products have new fields.
Minor: a few accessibility warnings (Missing Description/aria-describedby on DialogContent) appear in console — non-blocking but worth addressing for a11y compliance.
Minor: two 401 console errors on initial homepage load (likely /api/auth/me without cookie) — expected and silent, but could be suppressed if app checks for cookie before calling.

rca_of_issue: Fix verified: CheckoutPage now uses submitted state flag (setSubmitted(true) before navigate('/order-success')) which prevents the items.length===0 useEffect from overriding navigation to home. OrderSuccessPage wraps navigate('/') in useEffect to avoid render-time navigation. Startup migration in server.py backfills color_variants=[], video_url=None, total_sold=0 on existing product docs. All three fixes confirmed working.
